name: Icicle
text:
This +2 greater striking greater frost longspear appears to be a single continuous icicle stretching over 6 feet long. The icicle automatically extinguishes non-magical fires in a 20-foot emanation. While wielding it, you gain fire resistance 5.

---
Activate—Quench Flames 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect You swing the icicle into the area of an ongoing magical fire, and the spear attempts to counteract the fire with a counteract modifier of +27. If it fails, it can't attempt to counteract the same fire again.

---
Activate—Ice Spike 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The icicle grows rapidly, piercing creatures in a 30-foot line. Each creature in the area takes 11d6 cold damage with a DC 35 Reflex save. A creature that fails its save also takes 3d6 persistent,bleed damage (double on a critical failure).
